reasoning: On the season so far the Celtics are the stronger team; with home court the Celtics start about 5 points better, in a game of about 221 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Raptors.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Celtics win 66 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 193 and 241 total points.

analyst.text: Boston come in buoyant after a 123-101 rout in Philadelphia, where Paul George scored 36 against his former team, though they are on the second night of a back-to-back. Toronto are running thin: Scottie Barnes (groin) misses a third straight game, Kawhi Leonard is out at least another week, and Quickley is questionable. Toronto also face Philadelphia tomorrow. Confidence and health both lean toward Boston.
